messages.text: Map the chain from a Aerospace / Defense market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Signaling / Non-signaling Tester.

已查到可引用的部分資料：

| Aerospace / Defense market requirement | Measurable parameter | Required capability of Signaling / Non-signaling Tester |
|---|---|---|
| Deployed private 5G networks need resilience in smart jamming / EW environments, with tactical edge connectivity, contested spectrum, secure command-and-control, and autonomous systems / drones requiring low latency [23]. | Relevant measurable items available in the test knowledge base include BLER, throughput measurement, PER measurement, fading, AWGN, CSI report, and TX measurements [7]. | The tester needs 5G NR signaling / network emulation to connect the DUT and run RF, mobility, application, pre-conformance, and non-signaling R&D verification [6]. |
| The Aerospace & Defense test source frames the topic as making deployed 5G private networks more resilient against smart jamming / EW while keeping the DUT unmodified [18]. | A practical measurement chain can use sensitivity testing, high end-to-end throughput testing, SRS RF measurements, UL MIMO / UL CA RF measurements, and UL TX switching as test items [20]. | The tester needs both signaling and non-signaling coverage because CMX500 Callbox use cases include Go-NoGo, Non-Sig, Conformance, and R&D testing phases [31]. |
| The same knowledge base states that the 5G resilience work used R&S CMX500 as a network emulator, but warns this is not a binding CMX500 specification [34]. | CMX500 is documented as supporting NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, NB-IoT / NB-NTN signaling, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, plus fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [7]. | The required tester capability is therefore a one-box network emulation and measurement solution supporting 5G NR device testing across LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [7]. |
【推論】A defensible chain is: Aerospace / Defense private-5G resilience against smart jamming and contested spectrum → measure link robustness with BLER, throughput, PER, sensitivity, and RF TX items under fading / AWGN conditions → require a signaling / non-signaling tester that can emulate the network, connect the DUT, and perform RF, mobility, application, pre-conformance, and non-signaling verification [6][7][18][20][23].

來源：
[6] Wiki：CMX500 Callbox（來源：`CMX500_Callbox.md`、`CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32.md`、`CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100.md`）
[7] Wiki：R&S CMX500（來源：`CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32.md`、`CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100.md`）
[18] Wiki：Randy Schnell（來源：`2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.md`）
[20] Wiki：CMX500 Callbox（來源：`CMX500_Callbox.md`、`CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32.md`、`CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100.md`）
[23] Wiki：5G private network resilience against smart jamming（來源：`2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.md`、`5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100.md`）
[31] Wiki：CMX500 Callbox（來源：`CMX500_Callbox.md`、`CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32.md`、`CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100.md`）
[34] Wiki：5G private network resilience against smart jamming（來源：`2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.md`、`5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100.md`）

Space Supply Chain › 與既有知識的關係
- 與 [[4. Satellite Eco-chain in Taiwan]] 類似，本來源主要是 satellite / space supply chain link hub；兩者都含未擷取外部資料與未 OCR 圖片，不可直接當成已驗證供應鏈證據。
- 與 [[3. Satcom market summary]] 類似，本來源列出外部新聞與文章連結；在正文未擷取前，只能作為待讀索引。
- 與 [[0.Satcom Industry]]、[[台灣太空產業]]、[[台灣太空產業地圖]]、[[通訊衛星製造產業平台]]相關，但本來源沒有提供可直接增補的台灣太空產業地圖版本、公司名單、分類規則或政策資料。
- 與 [[低軌衛星零組件與地面終端供應鏈]]相關，但 Yahoo 連結標題中的 [[事欣科]] / AST 訂單說法尚未取得正文或公告，不更新該供應鏈表格。

事欣科
[[事欣科]]是 [[Space Supply Chain]] 中 Yahoo 股市文章連結標題括號內出現的公司名稱；本 vault 目前尚未擷取該新聞正文或公司公告。

Randy Schnell
[[Randy Schnell]] 是 [[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 封面列名的 Business Development Manager，Aerospace & Defense Test。

PARPRO › unresolved
- 需要擷取 `https://www.parpro.com.tw/solutions/aerospace-defense/` 正文。
- 需要確認 [[PARPRO]] 的正式公司名稱、所在地、產品線、產業分類與認證。
- 需要 OCR 來源中與該 URL 相鄰的圖片，確認是否為 PARPRO aerospace & defense 內容。

uTCI beam failure recovery
[[uTCI beam failure recovery]] 是 [[Unified TCI Framework]] 中 Release 17 unified TCI 對 legacy beam failure recovery procedure 的延伸，讓 BFR response 後的 QCL parameters 與 UL spatial filters 套用到 configured to follow unified TCI state 的 channels / signals。[[Unified TCI Framework(uTCI)]]

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

NTN signaling customer discovery › 2. Test layer
來源要求客戶指出要測試哪一層：

- RF
- Protocol
- Application Testing

這表示 discovery 階段需先分清楚測試目標，而不是只用「NTN testing」作為單一需求描述。

DCP-Config-r16 › 來源列出的相關欄位
[[Wake Up Signal]] 在描述 [[DCI format 2_6]] 時列出多個與 DCP / WUS 相關的 r16 欄位或參數：

- `ps-RNTI-r16`：對應 [[PS-RNTI]]。
- `ps-Offset-r16`：來源文字為 `ps-Offset-r16*0.125ms`，與 WUS search space relative to on-duration DRX cycle 的 timing 有關。
- `duration`：來源說 search space spans `duration` slots。
- `sizeDCI-2-6-r16`：DCI2_6 total length。
- `outsideActiveTimeConfig-r16`：for each UE defines the starting position of its bits inside the whole DCI。
- `ps-WakeUp-r16`：UE does not detect DCI 時的 default behavior，wake up 或 stay asleep。
- `ps-TransmitPeriodicL1CSI-r16`：on-duration cycle does not start 時仍可 transmit periodic L1-RSRP reports 的設定線索。
- `ps-TransmitOtherPeriodicCSI-r16`：on-duration cycle does not start 時仍可 transmit other periodic CSI reports 的設定線索。

R&S PCB test solutions › 流程整理
| 流程階段 | 來源明示量測 / 分析項目 | 相關概念 | 來源 | 日期 / 期間 | 限制 |

| Material Measurement | Impedance (TDR)、DK/DF extraction | [[TDR 阻抗測量]]、[[Dk-Df]] | [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]] | 封面日期 2026.3.4 | 未提供 fixture、頻率、標準或儀器型號 |
| Material/Stackup selection | IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance、Xtalk、TL modeling、Eye diagram | [[Insertion Loss]]、[[Dk-Df]]、[[表面粗糙度]]、[[阻抗變化]]、[[Crosstalk]]、[[Eye diagram]] | [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]] | 封面日期 2026.3.4 | 未提供 stackup rule、材料型號或 TL calculator 工具 |
| Signal Integrity modeling/testing | IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance | [[Signal Integrity]]、[[Dk-Df]]、[[TDR 阻抗測量]] | [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]] | 封面日期 2026.3.4 | 未提供 S-parameter、模型格式或驗證流程 |
| Sampling testing | IL、DK/DF、impedance | [[高頻高速 PCB 測試解決方案]] | [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]] | 封面日期 2026.3.4 | 未提供抽樣頻率、樣本數或允收條件 |
| PL / Process Monitoring | IL、DK/DF、impedance 等流程語境 | [[Process Monitoring]] | [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]] | 封面日期 2026.3.4 | PL 未展開；未提供 control limit 或 SPC 指標 |

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › Program / roadmap 脈絡
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 把 private 5G resilience 放入 defense / Future-G roadmap：

| 期間 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| 2025–2028 | widespread deployment of 5G tactical networks；mmWave phased arrays available for field testing；hybrid commercial / military networks such as 5G.MIL-style architectures |
| 2028–2032 | 5G/6G-capable software-defined radios replacing multi-radio tactical stacks；early [[ISAC]] deployment for drone detection and perimeter defense；[[URLLC]] services for autonomy |
| 2032–2035+ | full 6G networks with integrated sensing；AI-native battlefield connectivity；high-precision location sensing and spectrum-aware autonomy |

來源也列出 [[5G.MIL]]、[[Raytheon OXYGEN]]、[[L3Harris Tactical Network Demo]]、[[DoD EMS Superiority Strategy]] 與 [[FutureG ISAC]] / spectrum sharing programs，作為 FHSS 與 5G convergence 的 program examples。

passages.text:
R&S PCB test solutions
[[R&S PCB test solutions]] 是 [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]] Slide 21 對 PCB Fabricator and System House 的 PCB / high-speed digital 測試流程摘要，涵蓋 material measurement、stackup selection、signal integrity modeling/testing、sampling testing 與 process monitoring。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › 使用限制
- 本頁不是 [[RTCA DO-160]] 正式標準摘要；只保存 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 的簡報文字。
- 不得由本頁推論 DO-160G / DO-160 任何 section 的完整 category、limit、waveform、test setup 或 pass / fail criteria。
- 來源把 DO-160 放在 military / aviation drone example 中，但未說明特定 drone、eVTOL 或 avionics equipment 的 qualification plan。

衛星地面設備 › Satellite Ground Station / Operation and Control Center 線索
- [[Satellite Ground Station]]（raw converted 2026-09-17；來源正文未標示正式發布日期）列出 TASA | Satellite Operation and Control Center 外部連結。
- 該連結指向 TASA 網站的 `space-facilities/satellite/satellite-operation-and-control-center` URL。
- 本來源只提供 link hub 與未 OCR 圖片，尚未提供 [[Satellite Operation and Control Center]] 的正文內容。
- 因此，這筆資料只可作為後續查證 [[TASA]] / [[國家太空中心]] 衛星地面站或操作控制中心的入口，不可視為設施規格或能力證據。

Satellite Operation and Control Center › 可追溯限制
- [[Satellite Ground Station]] 尚未擷取 TASA 外部頁正文，因此不能確認 [[Satellite Operation and Control Center]] 的中文正式名稱、法律 / 組織歸屬、地址、設備、任務、操作衛星、天線規格或服務能力。
- 不得把外部連結標題改寫為 TASA 已公開某項地面站技術規格。
- 不得從檔名或圖片嵌入推論設施照片內容、天線數量、frequency band、tracking capability、mission control workflow 或客戶 / 任務關係。

經緯航太
[[經緯航太]] 是 [[0. UAV產業分析報告架構]] 中列於 [[台灣無人機供應鏈]] 下游的公司，來源描述其與智慧農業與多用途無人機相關；[[4. UAV Eco-chain in Taiwan]] 另在 System Integrator 區段列出經緯航太名稱。

Space Supply Chain
這份 OneNote 來源是 space / satellite supply chain 的外部資料與圖片 link hub，列出 [[Satellite Applications Catapult]] 的 Space Capabilities Catalogue、Yahoo 股市文章連結、[[PARPRO]] aerospace & defense solution 連結，以及多張未 OCR 圖片；本次 ingest 未擷取外部網頁正文，也未擷取圖片文字。

Randy Schnell › 來源中的列名
依 [[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]]（檔名 / raw title 含 2025-12-19；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- 封面列名：Randy Schnell。
- 職稱 / 角色列名：Business Development Manager。
- 組織 / 業務領域列名：Aerospace & Defense Test。
- 簡報主題為 deployed [[5G]] private networks 在 [[Smart Jamming]] / [[EW]] 環境下的 resilience，以及 legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] 能否在不修改 [[DUT]] 的前提下提升連線韌性。

uTCI beam failure recovery › Release 17 uTCI BFR behavior
Release 17 unified TCI 的 BFR 類似 legacy。來源指出：

- UE 從 NW 收到 beam failure recovery response 後 28 symbols，對所有 [[PDSCH]] / [[PDCCH]] 及其他 configured to follow unified TCI state 的 signals，假設使用與 candidate beam set 中 identified beam associated 的相同 [[QCL]] parameters。
- Uplink 方向上，UE 會將與 new beam 或 last PRACH transmission associated 的相同 spatial filters，用於所有 [[PUSCH]] / [[PUCCH]] 以及 configured to follow unified TCI state 的 signals。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

NTN signaling customer discovery › 4. Satellite architecture
來源詢問：

- 是否將 CMX 連接到 [[satellite gateway]]，在 real live satellite network 中測試。
- gateway 使用哪些 bands。
- satellite orbit：[[LEO]]、[[MEO]]、[[GEO]]、[[GSO]]。
- payload type：[[transparent satellite payload]] 或 [[regenerative satellite payload]]。

這些問題把 NTN 測試需求拆成 orbit、payload 與 gateway integration，而不是只停留在 waveform / protocol 名稱。

Network Infrastructure T&M drivers › 使用限制
- 本頁是簡報摘要，不是正式產品 roadmap、datasheet、quote configuration 或 standards compliance statement。
- 來源多處為圖像 / 產品組合 slide，markitdown 轉檔可能遺失圖片中細節。
- 不可由本頁推論產品正式規格、option code、availability、software version、校準附件或價格。
- `All 38.141 measurements supported`、`fully validated in QDART`、`compliant to O-RAN Alliance WG4` 等皆是簡報層級文字，需正式標準、datasheet、application note 或 certification record 補證。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › Mission context 與 industry drivers
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 列出的 mission / market drivers 包含：

- tactical edge connectivity needs；
- rise of smart jamming and improved [[EW]] tactics；
- complex RF environment 與 contested spectrum；
- growing adoption of private 5G networks；
- autonomous systems and drones requiring low latency；
- expansion of tactical private 5G networks on military bases；
- demand for secure command-and-control networks；
- strategic partnerships，例如來源提到 Nokia + L3Harris in 2024；
- multi-year contracts，例如來源提到 Northrop Grumman 5G battlefield networking in 2024。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 另稱 United States Department of Defense has recently embarked on a strategy leveraging both public and private 5G networks，並說 5G could become the de-facto communications network between NATO members。此為 white paper statement；來源未附完整 DoD / NATO 文件引用。

passages.text:
R&S PCB test solutions › 來源中的說法
[[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（封面日期 2026.3.4）Slide 21 題為 **R&S PCB test solutions**，副標為 **PCB Fabricator and System House**，列出以下流程與項目：

- **Material Measurement**：Impedance ([[TDR]])、DK/DF extraction。
- **Material/Stackup selection**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance、Xtalk、TL modeling、Eye diagram。
- **Signal Integrity modeling/testing**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance。
- **Sampling testing**：IL、DK/DF、impedance。
- **PL/Process Monitoring**：來源列在同一流程上，但未展開 PL。
- 圖上另列 [[SPEAG]]、[[SWISSTO12]]、[[QWED]]、[[KEYCOM]]、[[RSTW]]、TDR、Delta-L、ISD/ADK、ISD/ADK、w/ cable / connector testing 等文字。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing
[[DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing]] 是 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 中引用 [[RTCA DO-160]] 作為 airborne equipment environmental conditions and test procedures 的測試線索，用於 military / aviation drone EMC proposal context。

衛星地面設備 › 與既有頁面的關係
- [[低軌衛星零組件與地面終端供應鏈]] 已整理 2026-09-15 市場報告中的地面設備與用戶終端公司，例如 [[啟碁]]、[[耀登]]、[[鐳洋科技]]、[[稜研科技]]與[[濰元科技]]。
- [[Satellite User Terminal 外部資料清單]] 保存 [[User Terminal]] 來源中的 OneWeb / Kuiper / Starlink user terminal、test flow 與 supply-chain 待讀材料。
- [[相控陣列天線]] 是地面終端與電子掃描天線相關的主題；[[User Terminal]] 補入 flat-panel antenna、ESA、phased array OTA testing、active phased array characterization 等待讀連結。

- [[Satellite Operation and Control Center]] 是 [[Satellite Ground Station]] 新增的 TASA 外部頁線索，應待外部正文擷取後再判斷其與地面設備、ground station、mission control 或 satellite operations 的關係。

Wi-Fi 8 › 延續自 Wi-Fi 7 的 core PHY parameters
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]，[[Wi-Fi 8]] 保留下列 [[Wi-Fi 7]] core physical layer parameters：

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases

NTN signaling customer discovery

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 與既有頁面的關係
- [[DUT]]：本概念的限制條件是 unmodified 5G DUT。
- [[Handover frequency hopping]]：白皮書中最具體的 implementation。
- [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]]：本概念的主要技術方向。
- [[Smart Jamming]]：本概念要處理的 threat model。
- [[R&S CMX500]]：白皮書明示測試使用 CMX500 作為 network emulator；但該 Market source 不是 CMX500 binding specifications。
- [[Counter-UAV 技術]]：簡報 mid-term roadmap 提到 drone detection 與 perimeter defense，但不是 counter-UAV 系統評估來源。
- [[Beamforming]]：簡報短期 roadmap 提到 mmWave phased arrays field testing，但沒有 beamforming 定義或測試方法。

answer.text:
| Aerospace / Defense market requirement | Measurable parameter | Required capability of Signaling / Non-signaling Tester |
|---|---|---|
| Deployed private 5G networks need resilience in smart jamming / EW environments, with tactical edge connectivity, contested spectrum, secure command-and-control, and autonomous systems / drones requiring low latency [23]. | Relevant measurable items available in the test knowledge base include BLER, throughput measurement, PER measurement, fading, AWGN, CSI report, and TX measurements [7]. | The tester needs 5G NR signaling / network emulation to connect the DUT and run RF, mobility, application, pre-conformance, and non-signaling R&D verification [6]. |
| The Aerospace & Defense test source frames the topic as making deployed 5G private networks more resilient against smart jamming / EW while keeping the DUT unmodified [18]. | A practical measurement chain can use sensitivity testing, high end-to-end throughput testing, SRS RF measurements, UL MIMO / UL CA RF measurements, and UL TX switching as test items [20]. | The tester needs both signaling and non-signaling coverage because CMX500 Callbox use cases include Go-NoGo, Non-Sig, Conformance, and R&D testing phases [31]. |
| The same knowledge base states that the 5G resilience work used R&S CMX500 as a network emulator, but warns this is not a binding CMX500 specification [34]. | CMX500 is documented as supporting NR FR1 / NR FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, NB-IoT / NB-NTN signaling, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, plus fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [7]. | The required tester capability is therefore a one-box network emulation and measurement solution supporting 5G NR device testing across LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [7]. |
【推論】A defensible chain is: Aerospace / Defense private-5G resilience against smart jamming and contested spectrum → measure link robustness with BLER, throughput, PER, sensitivity, and RF TX items under fading / AWGN conditions → require a signaling / non-signaling tester that can emulate the network, connect the DUT, and perform RF, mobility, application, pre-conformance, and non-signaling verification [6][7][18][20][23].

cited_passages.text:
CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

Randy Schnell › 來源中的列名
依 [[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]]（檔名 / raw title 含 2025-12-19；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- 封面列名：Randy Schnell。
- 職稱 / 角色列名：Business Development Manager。
- 組織 / 業務領域列名：Aerospace & Defense Test。
- 簡報主題為 deployed [[5G]] private networks 在 [[Smart Jamming]] / [[EW]] 環境下的 resilience，以及 legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] 能否在不修改 [[DUT]] 的前提下提升連線韌性。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › Mission context 與 industry drivers
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 列出的 mission / market drivers 包含：

- tactical edge connectivity needs；
- rise of smart jamming and improved [[EW]] tactics；
- complex RF environment 與 contested spectrum；
- growing adoption of private 5G networks；
- autonomous systems and drones requiring low latency；
- expansion of tactical private 5G networks on military bases；
- demand for secure command-and-control networks；
- strategic partnerships，例如來源提到 Nokia + L3Harris in 2024；
- multi-year contracts，例如來源提到 Northrop Grumman 5G battlefield networking in 2024。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 另稱 United States Department of Defense has recently embarked on a strategy leveraging both public and private 5G networks，並說 5G could become the de-facto communications network between NATO members。此為 white paper statement；來源未附完整 DoD / NATO 文件引用。
